mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies around the Military Ridge State Trail with an overnight low of 53 degrees and no rain in the forecast. If you look up at 9:19 PM, you can catch the ISS flying high in the sky, traveling from the direction of Cross Plains over toward Oregon near Costco.

In city news, the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to discuss various development projects, including site plans for Liberty Business Park. Also, remember that fall leaf collection kicks off that same day, so please keep leaf piles off the street and away from hydrants or mailboxes.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can check out live music at Paddy Mac's, visit the downtown farmer's market, grab pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or join trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, we have trivia at Hop Haus tomorrow, and the popular Verona Fall Fest coming up on September 25.
For our weekly report, officers responded on September 10 to a burglary at Hunters Cove Way where a suspect was detained after a firearm was discharged during the incident.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10 PM, but please be aware that they are closed today for a facility remodel, so we look forward to their return.
